description: This PHP file contains class definitions and functions related to the installation process of SuiteCRM, including layout rendering, localization, and configuration setup. It also includes license and copyright information.

classes.name: NonDBLocalization
classes.description: Class for handling localization options without database dependency, including locale name formats.

classes.name: InstallLayout
classes.description: Class providing static methods for generating HTML layout components for the installation pages.

methods.name: NonDBLocalization::__construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing default locale name format based on global configuration.

methods.name: NonDBLocalization::getUsableLocaleNameOptions
methods.description: Creates localized dropdown options filtering invalid formats.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getSelect
methods.description: Generates an HTML select element with options and default selection.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getHeaderStyles
methods.description: Returns HTML link tags for header stylesheets.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getHeaderScripts
methods.description: Returns HTML script tags for header JavaScript files.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getHeader
methods.description: Generates the HTML header section for install pages.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getForm
methods.description: Generates the HTML form layout for install steps.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getOutput
methods.description: Assembles the full HTML page for the install step.

methods.name: InstallLayout::getFormItems
methods.description: Generates form items for database configuration, site settings, localization, branding, and scenario selection.
